annotations.title: Prepare a booking for the guest

description: Keeps a stay (check_in and check_out) or a time slot (date, start_time, end_time) at one listing, with the name and contacts of the person booking, and returns a link to a Roraima page where that person checks the booking and pays, with these details already filled in. Availability and price are checked as in get_quote. The link carries only a random code, works once and expires after two hours; the details are then deleted. This answer does not repeat the name or the contacts. The booking exists only once it is paid on the page.

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD (listings booked by nights).

date.description: Day of the time slot, YYYY-MM-DD (listings booked by time slots).

first_name.description: First name of the person booking.

language.description: Language of names, descriptions and page links. Default en.

last_name.description: Last name of the person booking.

phone.description: Phone of the person booking, with the international prefix (for example +39...). Used only where the checkout of the listing asks for a phone number.

name: prepare_booking
title: Prepare a booking for the guest
